registered: see the git commit that added this file (2026-10-12): after the X1 / X2 TEST passes (whose results are known and are NOT used here), before any P1 computation
class: EXPLORATORY follow-up on TRAIN / VAL only. No TEST access, no TEST claim. A TEST evaluation of any P1 outcome needs its own registration and an authorised TEST budget.
motivation_val_only: explore/presence_v3_n__causal_g4_cst_s0_e20.json (CST VAL, X1's frozen cross-fitted STE): absent-frame false alarms are 10 % and wrong-object boxes 17 % of the frame-SA loss; their associated detection scores (median 0.52 / 0.51) are far below those of correct frames (median 0.78; AUC 0.88). The STE couples association and output through one threshold det_thr (grid max 0.3).
hypothesis: an output (presence) gate decoupled from association -- the STE keeps its state and associations, but reports 'absent' when the associated detection score (or its short exponential average) is below tau_out -- raises cross-fitted CST VAL mSA

candidate.tracker: experiments/systems/scripts/ste.py unchanged; a wrapper replaces an output box by 'absent' when gate(score) < tau_out; init frame (given ground truth) always output

variants.instant: gate = score of the frame's associated detection (0 when coasting)
variants.ema: gate = 0.5 * score_t + 0.5 * gate_{t-1}, reset to 1 at init

candidate.unchanged: detector, detections (cached), the STE settings of each VAL half = track_eval's cross-fitted params_per_half of the run

selection: cross-fitted over track_eval's two VAL halves: (variant, tau_out) chosen on one half by maximum mSA, applied to the other; tau_out = 0 (= the frozen STE) is in the grid, so 'no change' can be selected
primary_comparison: per run: cross-fitted per-sequence SA of the gated STE minus the frozen STE's cross-fitted per-sequence SA (40 CST VAL sequences), sequence bootstrap B = 10000 (default_rng(0)), Wilcoxon alongside
acceptance_rule: PROMISING iff the bootstrap CI lower bound > 0 for at least 2 of the 3 runs AND the 3-run mean delta > 0.3 SA; HARMFUL iff the CI upper bound < 0 for at least 2 runs; else NO_GAIN
secondary_descriptive: absent-frame false-alarm rate, visible-frame miss rate and located rate of both trackers (the trade-off, not one metric)
chosen (variant, tau_out) per half and run
caveat: CST VAL shares source videos with CST TRAIN (paper section 3.3); VAL gains are optimistic and not a benchmark claim
compute: CPU only, single process on the OMEN: 3 runs x 18 gate settings x 40 sequences re-using one STE pass per sequence and half (minutes)
